```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const countdown = document.querySelector("[data-countdown]");
  if (!countdown) return;

  const deadline = new Date(countdown.dataset.deadline);
  if (Number.isNaN(deadline.getTime())) return;

  const status = countdown.querySelector("[data-countdown-status]");
  const date = countdown.querySelector("[data-countdown-date]");
  const dday = countdown.querySelector("[data-countdown-dday]");
  const hours = countdown.querySelector("[data-countdown-hours]");
  const minutes = countdown.querySelector("[data-countdown-minutes]");
  const seconds = countdown.querySelector("[data-countdown-seconds]");
  const pad = (value) => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
  let timerId;

  const setText = (node, value) => {
    if (node) node.textContent = value;
  };

  const updateCountdown = () => {
    const remaining = deadline.getTime() - Date.now();

    if (remaining <= 0) {
      countdown.dataset.state = "closed";
      countdown.setAttribute("aria-label", "SHIFT 신입 부원 모집이 종료되었습니다.");
      setText(status, "모집 종료");
      setText(date, "마감되었습니다");
      setText(dday, "D-0");
      setText(hours, "00");
      setText(minutes, "00");
      setText(seconds, "00");
      window.clearInterval(timerId);
      return;
    }

    const totalSeconds = Math.floor(remaining / 1000);
    const dayCount = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
    const hourCount = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600) % 24;
    const minuteCount = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60) % 60;
    const secondCount = totalSeconds % 60;

    countdown.dataset.state = "open";
    setText(status, dayCount === 0 ? "오늘 마감" : "모집 마감");
    setText(dday, dayCount === 0 ? "D-DAY" : `D-${dayCount}`);
    setText(hours, pad(hourCount));
    setText(minutes, pad(minuteCount));
    setText(seconds, pad(secondCount));
  };

  updateCountdown();
  timerId = window.setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
})();
</script>
```
:::
